# dsh-claude-harness
One package for the whole "make DeepSeek Harness look like Claude" job on macOS.
| Piece | Delivered by |

| Claude Code style UI | `dsh-claude-style` (declared dependency; installed together) |
| Claude app

icon | this package — `assets/Claude.icns` → `Contents/Resources/icon.icns` |
| App name "Claude Ha
rness" | this package — `CFBundleName` / `CFBundleDisplayName` + the `.app` filename |

Loading the plugin never changes the app by itself. Branding is opt-in (`apply`),
because a half-app
lied code signature is what makes macOS kill the app on launch.

Into a DSH profile — from GitHub:

Restart the app afterwards — plugin rows are read at startup.

Run `dsh-claude-harness apply` again after every app update: an update replaces the
bundle, so the i
con and the name come back as DeepSeek.
## What `apply` does, in order

1. refuses anything whose `CFBundleIdentifier` is not `com.deepseek.dsh`;
2. backs up `Info.plist` +

ndleName` / `CFBundleDisplayName` to `Claude Harness`;
5. re-signs ad-hoc, **top level only** (`code

sign --force --sign -`;
`--deep` fails on the running helper subcomponents with "Operation not permi
rifies `codesign --verify` passes.
Steps 3–5 are skipped when the values already match, so re-running is cheap.
## 中文衬线体
`dsh-claude-style` 的衬线字体栈以 `"Anthropic Serif Web Text","Claude Style Noto Serif"` 开头，但这两个族名都没有汉字字形（插
件自带的 Noto Serif 是 802 字形的拉丁子集），所以汉字会一路回退到栈尾的 `"Noto Sans SC","PingFang SC"` —— 衬线标题里的中文全成了黑体。
插件的浏览器半边（`lib/client.js`，随本包一起加载）给栈里第一个族名补了一个**只覆盖汉字**的 `@font-face`：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
汉字走系统宋体，拉丁字母仍由 Anthropic Serif 出图，两边互不打扰。不装 Anthropic 字体也照样生效（栈里第一个族名没有可用字形时，浏览器继续找同族的下一张 face）。
## Notes

- macOS only (`os: ["darwin"]`), Node ≥ 22.6.
- 字体设置选「跟随宿主」时字体栈只有 `--dsw-font-family`（无衬线），中文衬线体补丁不介

入。
- Ad-hoc re-signing resets TCC grants; macOS may ask again for folder access.
- `restore` puts ba

ck the plist/icon/name from the backup, not a different app version.
- The icon: 1024×1024 squircle,

`#D97757`, with the Claude mark centred by pixel
centroid. Source `assets/icon.html` → `assets/Clau

de.icns`.
- Check: `npm test` — `test/branding.test.mjs` builds a throwaway fake bundle and
exercise

s apply → no-op → restore against the real `codesign`;
`test/routes.test.mjs` drives the HTTP handle

r with a mock request/response;
`test/client.test.mjs` runs the browser half against a minimal DOM s

th a mock request/response;
`test/client.test.mjs` runs the browser half against a minimal DOM stub.

Claude Code style UI comes
from dsh-claude-style.
